method: Whole-view comparison of each panorama (1148x1063, pitched up) with its dry render at the same size from the same camera at 90 degree vertical field of view; positions read on each feature's own row.
note: One panorama about 4.2 m from the gable, resected on the south corner and on the base row (camera 2.3 m, residuals under 3 px). It puts the north corner at y 24.41, 0.63 m short of the district outline: a gap closed at the street by white boarding separates the house from the pass 70 infill house. The zone ends at the measured corner and the strip is released; pass 70 draws that house's south wall only above the district height, so this pass completes the wall below it. Eaves and apex are measured; the roof's rear half and the yard side are estimates.
